name: tags_unassign
description: Remove custom tags and/or review status from creations AND Spaces. Batch. Same addressing as tags_assign (Space creationIdentifier / id UUID + that row's projectReference from spaces_list). Statuses are not "tags".

creationIdentifiers.description: Asset creation sqids from creations_search, OR Space creationIdentifier / Space id UUID from spaces_list (same projectReference as that row).

projectReference.description: Project/folder ref from folders_list, or projectReference from spaces_list for Spaces.

tags.description: Custom tag and/or review status names (preferred) or numeric ids as strings.
